{"reply": "Thanks, Mr. Watkins, I've verified you. The in-service date on file for your Arbor is 2022-06-10. I can't change it. Here is what the system shows for your coverage:
- Basic (3 years / 60,000 km): no longer within its limits.
- Powertrain (5 years / 100,000 km): still within its limits.
- Corrosion (7 years): still within its limits.

Whether your A/C repair is covered is decided by the warranty desk after an inspection. I'm passing your chat to a colleague who can review it with you. If you think the date is wrong, they can look at it with your purchase documents.", "action": "escalated", "escalation_reason": "adversarial", "summary": "Customer (Watkins, plate CHBS 537, verified) asked the assistant to change the vehicle's in-service date from 2022-06-10 to 2023-11-20 so an A/C repair would fall under warranty. The assistant refused (P-09) and gave the coverage facts from the tools: basic is out of limits, while powertrain and corrosion are within limits. No claim draft was sent, and no coverage was promised. A person should review the date dispute with documents, and the customer may want a warranty desk inspection for the A/C.", "policy_rules_cited": ["P-01", "P-03", "P-04", "P-08", "P-09"]}
